scripts.test: sh -c '[ "$1" = -- ] && shift; node ../infra/scripts/has-tests.ts unit db stack "$@"; s=$?; [ $s -eq 3 ] && [ $# -eq 0 ] && exit 0; [ $s -eq 3 ] && { echo "no test file matches: $*" >&2; exit 1; }; [ $s -eq 0 ] || exit 1; pnpm run test:unit -- "$@" && pnpm run test:db -- "$@" && pnpm run test:stack -- "$@"' test
scripts.test:unit: sh -c '[ "$1" = -- ] && shift; exec vitest run --project unit "$@"' vitest
scripts.test:db: sh -c '[ "$1" = -- ] && shift; node ../infra/scripts/has-tests.ts db "$@" || exit $(( $? == 3 ? 0 : 1 )); pnpm -w test:env && exec node ../infra/scripts/test-slot.ts vitest run --project db "$@"' vitest
scripts.test:stack: sh -c '[ "$1" = -- ] && shift; node ../infra/scripts/has-tests.ts stack "$@" || exit $(( $? == 3 ? 0 : 1 )); pnpm -w test:env && exec node ../infra/scripts/test-slot.ts vitest run --project stack "$@"' vitest
